title: A Close Reading Approach to Gender Narrative Biases in AI-Generated Stories
reasoning: The paper focuses on gender narrative biases and stereotypical character representation in AI-generated stories using a literary close reading approach. While it mentions character traits such as 'ethical strength' or 'moral alignment' as descriptors, these are analyzed within the framework of gender-based stereotyping and narrative functions rather than as a formal evaluation or benchmarking of religious, spiritual, or ethical systems.
